privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: How Kharji collects, uses, and protects your data.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: Kharji ("we", "us", or "the Service") is a personal finance tracker available at kharji.app. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. We collect only what is needed to run the Service — nothing more.

infoCollect.title: Information We Collect
infoCollect.account: Account information. When you sign up we collect your email address, your name (optional), and a password. Passwords are never stored in plain text — they are hashed with an industry-standard key derivation function (PBKDF2) before being saved.
infoCollect.financial: Financial data you enter. Expenses, income entries, assets, tags, categories, and related notes that you add to your account. This data exists solely so the Service can work for you. We never sell it, share it with advertisers, or use it for any purpose other than providing the Service to you.
infoCollect.analytics: Usage analytics. We use Vercel Analytics to collect anonymous, aggregated page-view statistics. This does not use cookies and does not track you across sites.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use a single, essential session cookie to keep you signed in. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.item1: To provide the Service: storing and displaying your financial data, calculating summaries and reports.
howWeUse.item2: To authenticate you and keep your account secure.
howWeUse.item3: To send transactional emails (such as a welcome email, password reset links, and periodic financial reports). You can unsubscribe from report emails at any time via the link in the email or from Settings.
howWeUse.item4: To fetch exchange rates so amounts can be shown in your preferred currency.

whereDataLives.title: Where Your Data Lives
whereDataLives.body: Your data is stored in a Turso (libSQL) database and the application is hosted on Vercel. Transactional emails are delivered through Resend. These providers process data on our behalf and are bound by their own privacy and security commitments.

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.body: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We share data only with the infrastructure providers listed above, to the extent necessary to operate the Service, or if required by law.

yourRights.title: Your Rights and Choices
yourRights.export: Export. You can export all of your data at any time from Settings.
yourRights.delete: Delete. You can permanently delete your account and all associated data from Settings. Deletion is immediate and irreversible.
yourRights.correct: Correct. You can edit or delete any entry you have created directly in the app.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.body: We keep your data for as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, all of your data — expenses, income, assets, tags, and account details — is permanently removed from our database.

security.title: Security
security.body: All traffic to the Service is encrypted over HTTPS. Passwords are hashed and salted. Access to your data requires authentication with your credentials. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, but we take reasonable measures to protect your information.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.body: The Service is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will update the "Last updated" date above and, where appropriate, notify you by email.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.metaDescription: The terms that govern your use of Kharji.

agreement.title: Agreement
agreement.body: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of Kharji, the personal finance tracker available at kharji.app ("the Service"). By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

service.title: The Service
service.body: Kharji lets you track expenses, income, and assets, view reports and summaries, and convert amounts between currencies using third-party exchange rates. The Service is provided as-is and may change over time as features are added, modified, or removed.

account.title: Your Account
account.item1: You must provide a valid email address to create an account.
account.item2: You are responsible for keeping your password secure and for all activity under your account.
account.item3: You must be at least 13 years old to use the Service.
account.item4: One person may not maintain accounts for the purpose of abusing or disrupting the Service.

yourData.title: Your Data
yourData.body: You own the financial data you enter into Kharji. We claim no rights over it beyond what is needed to store and display it back to you. You can export your data or permanently delete your account (and all of its data) at any time from Settings. How we handle your data is described in our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.item1: Use the Service for any unlawful purpose.
acceptableUse.item2: Attempt to gain unauthorized access to other users' accounts or data.
acceptableUse.item3: Interfere with or disrupt the Service, its servers, or its networks.
acceptableUse.item4: Scrape, resell, or redistribute the Service or its data without permission.

notAdvice.title: Not Financial Advice
notAdvice.body: Kharji is a record-keeping and visualization tool. Nothing in the Service — including summaries, reports, charts, or exchange-rate conversions — constitutes financial, investment, tax, or legal advice. Exchange rates are sourced from third parties and are provided for convenience; we do not guarantee their accuracy.

availability.title: Availability and Warranty Disclaimer
availability.body: The Service is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the Service will be uninterrupted, error-free, or that data will never be lost. We recommend exporting your data periodically.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Kharji and its operator shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or any loss of profits, data, or goodwill, arising from your use of (or inability to use) the Service.

termination.title: Termination
termination.body: You may stop using the Service and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or that harm the Service or other users. Upon termination, your data is deleted as described in the Privacy Policy.

changes.title: Changes to These Terms
changes.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. If we make material changes, we will update the "Last updated" date above and, where appropriate, notify you by email. Continued use of the Service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

more.title: More
more.body: How we handle your data is described in our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
